# Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI

Skills that teach agents to work with Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI. They are copied from the vendor's repository, [atlassian-labs/twg-plugins](https://github.com/atlassian-labs/twg-plugins), at commit `b3336ef`.

Teamwork Graph CLI is Atlassian's agent-first interface to your entire work context: Jira issues, Confluence pages, Bitbucket PRs, along with your connected third-party data sources.

## Install

- **BoldCreate Connect:** open **Marketplace**, find **Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI**, and click **Install**.
- **Cursor:** add this repository as a team marketplace, then install **Atlassian Teamwork Graph CLI**.
- **Claude Code:** `/plugin marketplace add syncfusion/BoldCreate-Plugins`, then `/plugin install atlassian-twg-cli@boldcreate-plugins`.

## Skills

1 skill: `twg-setup`.

## Setup

No install-time settings.

## Before you install

It ships no scripts. The skills are guidance for the agent.

1 document show install commands that pipe a download into a shell (`curl ... | sh`). The agent may suggest them. Read the script before you run it.
